title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and your letter of 12 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

Your letter of 6 July confirms that your nickel and alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so a fixed price without a surcharge clause fits your own cost position.

The attached packages give you a longer volume commitment for planning security. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the bar would meet our specification?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

For our primary proposal, we can present a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. As our fixed-price material coverage concludes in March 2027, a 36-month agreement necessitates the inclusion of an AS-14404 index clause. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our technical department will gladly review your specifications to determine whether a more economical variant of the bar is suitable. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Please note this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - fixed-price package for 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer and for offering a technical review of the specification. We would welcome it.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The attached package keeps our 36-month commitment and 60-day payment, with a fixed price and no surcharge clause. Your material coverage runs until March 2027, so a fixed price matches your own cost position for the first part of the term. It also removes the monthly index administration on both sides.

Your owner offered in April to walk us through your calculation. We would gladly take up that offer if it helps settle this package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - fixed-price package for 36 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Because our material coverage concludes in March 2027, a 36-month agreement must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage subsequent risk. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We would be pleased to arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation and discuss the package further.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part:370010 – revised fixed-price package, 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the improved offer and for explaining your material coverage.

We have moved our price in the attached package. It keeps the same structure as before: a fixed price with no surcharge clause, 60-day payment and a 36-month term covering 94,800 kg per year. A fixed price removes the monthly index administration for both sides. Your coverage until March 2027 also matches the start of the term.

Could you also confirm your earliest lead time for the first call-off in January 2027, given your holiday shutdown?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – revised fixed-price package, 36 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We are always keen to support your requirements with our extensive inventory and reliable service. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.04 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We must reinstate the AS-14404 index clause for a 36-month term, as our material coverage ends in March 2027. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.16 per unit, a price of €5.16 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please provide the data for the 94,800 kg per year volume you mentioned, so we can verify it. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
